subject: german
title: Stamp 2: Fridays for Future
welcome_lead: Stamp the youth climate movement that swept Germany.
meta_desc: A-Level German adventure on Fridays for Future, Greta Thunberg, and climate activism.

concepts.def: Global youth climate movement begun by Greta Thunberg in 2018.
Swedish activist whose school strike inspired the movement.
School strike; main form of action by FFF, on Fridays.
Leading German FFF activist and public figure.
Climate emergency declaration adopted by many German cities from 2019.
Last Generation; more radical climate group using disruptive tactics from 2021.

walkthroughs.body_html: Thunberg started her solo school strike in August 2018. By March 2019 over a million students worldwide joined; in September 2019, Berlin saw 270,000 demonstrators.
Luisa Neubauer became the most prominent German FFF face. She helped lead a 2021 constitutional complaint that forced the government to tighten its climate targets.
Letzte Generation activists glue themselves to roads and target art frames. Debates rage over whether such tactics aid or harm climate politics; public support has fluctuated.
